Load libraries
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratObject)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(gprofiler2)
library(STEAM)
```


Load SC se object:
```{r}
se <- readRDS("Seurat_objects/Postnatal_human_seurat_v5_subset_300_filtered_Metacell_SCTransform.rds")
se

table(se$cell_anno)
```

Load DEG genes
```{r}
DEG_genes <- read_csv2("DEG_output/DE_genes.csv")
DEG_genes <- as.data.frame(DEG_genes)
DEG_genes$p_val_adj <- as.numeric(DEG_genes$p_val_adj)
DEG_genes <- subset(DEG_genes, subset = p_val_adj <= 0.05) # using only significant DEG
```


Load Open Targets gene list
```{r}
OpenTargets_MDD_Genetic_ <- as.character(t(read.table(file = "data/OpenTargets/ranked_gene_sets/OT-MONDO_0002009-associated-targets-9_15_2026-v26_06_weights_genetics_only_MDD_ranked.csv")))
length(OpenTargets_MDD_Genetic_)
```


Filter out genes not present in the Seurat object.
```{r}
# Extract gene names from the Seurat object
gene_names <- rownames(se)

# Remove genes not present in the Seurat object from the gene lists
OpenTargets_MDD_Genetic_ <- unique(OpenTargets_MDD_Genetic_[OpenTargets_MDD_Genetic_ %in% gene_names])
length(OpenTargets_MDD_Genetic_)
```



Run Fisher's exact test.
```{r}
fisher_results <- run_fisher_test_degs(se, DEG_genes = DEG_genes, OT_genes = OpenTargets_MDD_Genetic_)
fisher_results
```


Plot results.
```{r, fig.height=10, fig.width=25}
# Ensure clusters are ordered by significance
fisher_results$cluster <- factor(fisher_results$cluster, 
                                 levels = fisher_results$cluster[order(fisher_results$adj_p_value)])

# Create the updated plot with viridis scale
p2 <- ggplot(fisher_results, aes(x = cluster, color = -log10(p_value), y = -log10(adj_p_value), size = odds_ratio)) +
  geom_point() +  
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +  
  scale_color_viridis(option = "D", direction = 1, name = "-log10(p-value)") +  # Use Viridis color scale
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 8), name = "Odds ratio") +  
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1,size = 14),axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),legend.title = element_text(size = 14),legend.text = element_text(size = 12)) +  
  labs(title = "All MDD genes",
       x = "Cell types",
       y = "-log10(adj p-value)") +
  guides(color = guide_colorbar(order = 1), size = guide_legend(order = 2))

p2
```


# NSC

```{r}
# Subset DEGs for the cluster of interest
cluster_NSC <- DEG_genes[DEG_genes$cluster == "NSC", ]
  
# Identify genetically associated genes
cluster_NSC$Genetically_Associated <- cluster_NSC$gene %in% OpenTargets_MDD_Genetic_

# A: Genetically associated & DE
genetically_associated_DE_genes_NSC <- cluster_NSC[cluster_NSC$Genetically_Associated == TRUE, ]

# Print the genes that are both genetically associated and differentially expressed
print("Genes that are genetically associated and DE for NSC:")
print(genetically_associated_DE_genes_NSC$gene)

Genes_NSC <- genetically_associated_DE_genes_NSC$gene
```


Make sure that Genes_NSC is ordered in the order of smallest p_val_adj 
```{r}
DEG_genes_NSC <- subset(DEG_genes, cluster == "NSC" )

DEG_genes_NSC <- DEG_genes_NSC %>%
  arrange(p_val_adj)

Genes_NSC_ordered <- Genes_NSC[order(match(Genes_NSC, DEG_genes_NSC))]
Genes_NSC_ordered
length(Genes_NSC_ordered)
```


GO analysis
```{r}
gostres <- gost(query = Genes_NSC_ordered, 
                organism = "hsapiens", ordered_query = TRUE, # Biological processes
                multi_query = FALSE, significant = T, exclude_iea = FALSE, 
                measure_underrepresentation = FALSE, evcodes = T, 
                user_threshold = 0.05, correction_method = "g_SCS", 
                domain_scope = "annotated", custom_bg = NULL, 
                numeric_ns = "", sources = NULL, as_short_link = FALSE)

```


```{r}
gostplot(gostres, capped = TRUE, interactive = F)
```


```{r}
results <- gostres$result
results <- results[grep("GO:BP",results$source), ]
results <- arrange(results,p_value)
```

Save GO results
```{r, eval=T}
write_delim(results, "DEG_output/GO_analysis/GO_Genes_MDD_all_genes_NSC.csv", delim = ";")
```


```{r}

results_plot <- na.omit(results[1:20,])

p <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    data = results_plot, 
    aes(
      x = reorder(term_name, -log10(p_value)), 
      y = -log10(p_value),
      size = intersection_size/term_size  # map size
    ), 
    color = "grey50",  # outline color
    fill = "grey70",   # fill color (uniform)
    shape = 21
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "GO:BP", 
    y = "-log10(adj.p-value)", 
    size = "GeneRatio"
  ) +
  ggtitle("MDD: NSC", subtitle = "Top 20") +
  guides(fill = "none")  # remove fill legend if still present

cowplot::plot_grid(p, ncol = 1)
```
